images.usedBy: Signals panel (planned): card art and the report
images.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: one cinematic illustration for a Signals card in Stellar Syndicates, a persistent science-fiction colony and trading game. One of a series of thirteen deep-space discovery paintings that must read as one set.
Input image 1: STYLE AND WORLD reference only, the approved opening-slideshow first-landing illustration. Match its realistic cinematic science-fiction painting, grounded materials and restrained detail. Create the new scene below, not a copy of that composition.
Input image 2: SUBJECT reference only: the exploration map sprite of a split freighter wreck (client/art-src/exploration/derelict.png). Keep its split hull and loose pods; repaint it in the series' painted style.
Composition/framing: one opaque wide landscape 16:9 illustration, exactly 1672 x 941 pixels. One strong focal subject near the centre, with every essential detail inside the central 60% of the width and the middle 45% of the height, so the image survives a wide 21:9 banner crop and still reads as a 384-pixel card. Quiet dark space toward the edges. Full frame, not a collage. The game adds titles and buttons outside the image.
Series look: seen from a nearby ship in open space close to a young colony's home star. A distant warm star low in one corner, a faint nebula haze, a sparse starfield. The subject lit from one side by that star and by its own small lights. Cold blue-black space with one warm or signature accent per scene.
Primary request: a dead independent freighter drifting in two pieces.
Subject: a mid-sized cargo hull torn apart at its midsection, the two halves slowly separating, a few cargo containers spilling into space, stripped cables trailing between the pieces, a short row of amber emergency lights still blinking along the spine. Silver-grey titanium, scorched edges.
Accent and mood: warm amber emergency lights against cold space; still and abandoned.
Constraints: no labels, text, numbers, logos, emblems, flags, skulls, watermark, border or interface. No planet filling the frame, no spacecraft other than the subject, no explosions, fire or weapons fire, no people unless stated. Output one finished full-frame opaque 1672 x 941 illustration, no crop or upscale.
